entity_raw.definition_raw: Your drow blood is particularly strong.   Prerequisites: Drow-blooded and drow magic racial traits, half-elf. Benefit: You count as a drow for any effects that relate to race. Furthermore, the spell-like abilities granted to you by your drow magic racial trait count as drow spell-like abilities for the purposes of any feat prerequisites.
